---
title: "SPEC-4.2.0-v002"
subtitle: "Tour responsiveness, guide numbering, domain sort order, Escape key"
---

## Overview

Follow-up fixes on the 4.2.0 batch, from hands-on testing of the tour, the
user guide, website categorization, and destructive-action dialogs.

## 1. Interactive tour responsiveness

Clicking **Next** had two visible delays: first before the bubble's text
changed, then before the bubble moved to its new position.

- **Root cause of the first delay**: the current step index lived in `App`
  state, so every step change re-rendered the entire App tree (the full
  tab grid with its live thumbnail iframes). The index now lives inside
  `OnboardingTour` itself — advancing a step re-renders only the small
  overlay, and App just knows whether the tour is open (`showTour`
  boolean, replacing `onboardingIndex`).
- **Second delay**: the anchored element re-measure ran again 250 ms after
  each step and always produced a new rect object, forcing a reposition
  pass; the spotlight also animated over 300 ms. The re-measure now runs
  at 120 ms and keeps the previous rect when nothing moved; the spotlight
  transition is 150 ms.
- The **Tour Steps** panel's list was capped at `max-h-64` (~9 rows); it
  now grows to `calc(100vh - 240px)`, so all steps are visible without
  scrolling on a reasonably tall window.
- **Escape** ends the tour (same as End Tour / X).

## 2. User guide numbered lists

The install steps all rendered as "1." — the markdown parser treated the
blank line between numbered items as the end of the list, so each item
became its own single-item list. List parsing now:

- continues across blank lines when the next non-blank line is another
  item of the same kind,
- renders indented `- ` lines as proper **nested sub-bullets** (previously
  folded inline into the parent item's text),
- honors the source's starting number via `<ol start>`.

## 3. Website sort order

Domain sections (Categorize by Website) and the sidebar domain picker now
sort by **significance**: the 2nd-level label first, then the TLD, then
3rd/4th/... levels right-to-left — so `amazon.com` sorts before
`aaa.nyc.gov`, and all `*.google.com` subdomains sit together. Implemented
as `compareDomains` in `services/sortUtils.ts`.

## 4. Destructive-dialog prominence + Escape key

- `ConfirmModal` gained a `warning` prop rendered as a prominent block —
  larger bold red text on a red-tinted bordered panel with an alert icon.
  The two irreversible dialogs (Close Tabs, Close Window) moved their
  "This cannot be undone." sentence into it. The Reorganize dialog keeps a
  plain message (that action is undoable).
- **Escape** now works everywhere it intuitively should, closing the most
  immediate thing first:
  1. an open dropdown menu (export, help, settings, sort menus, move menu,
     search scope, sidebar domain picker, preview tab picker) — closes just
     that menu;
  2. an open modal (confirm, prompt, merge, API key, user guide, error) or
     context menu — closes it (each handles its own Escape; the app-level
     handler stands back while one is open);
  3. the search field, when focused — clears the query;
  4. otherwise, if any tabs are checked — **unchecks all tabs**.
  Component-local dropdowns stop the event's propagation so a single press
  never both closes a menu and clears checks.

## Version

Remains **4.2.0** (these fixes ship with the still-unreleased 4.2.0
changes described in SPEC-4.2.0-v001).
